allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the exchange regarding allotment of fully paid-up equity shares on rights basis.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding closure of issue period of the rights issue.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'the letter of offer dated February 16, 2026 for the rights Issue of equity shares '.

allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the exchange regarding the rights issue.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited ("Company") has informed the exchange that the board of directors of the Company, at its meeting held on February 13, 2026 , has approved certain minor corrections/alignments to the rights issue terms.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited ("Company") has informed the exchange that the board of directors of the Company at its meeting held on February 12, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 9, i.e 2  (two) rights equity shares for every 9 (nine) equity shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 64 per equity share.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sical Logistics Limited ("Company") has informed the exchange that the board of directors of the Company at its meeting held on January 23, 2026, considered and approved (i) fund raising by way of a rights issue; and (ii) availing of additional credit facilities from HDFC Bank Limited.
